About

Senior-level SEO, hands on the keyboard.

I've spent 4+ years running SEO for travel brands, Saudi e-commerce stores, international schools, real-estate platforms and B2B engineering firms — three years in-house at Memphis Tours, now as Senior SEO Specialist at Road9 Media and as an independent consultant.

I work directly with your developers and content team: auditing the site, fixing what blocks crawling and indexing, rebuilding the information architecture, and shipping pages that rank and convert — on WordPress, Zid, Salla, Wix, Joomla or a custom stack.

A translation degree (B.A. Spanish–English, Ain Shams University) makes multilingual and international SEO native territory, not an afterthought.

On-Page SEO

20 tasks included

Every important page on your site optimized to rank for the right searches and to earn the click. This is where most of my client results start.

Keywords & search intent

  • Keyword research for every page, in Arabic, English or Spanish
  • Search-intent check, so each page answers what searchers actually want
  • Keyword-to-URL map: one main keyword per page, no overlap
  • Cannibalization check: find and merge pages competing for the same query

Page elements

  • Title tags rewritten for rankings and click-through rate
  • Meta descriptions with a clear benefit and call to action
  • Clean, keyword-focused URL slugs (with 301 redirects if changed)
  • Correct H1–H3 heading structure on every page
  • Image alt text, file names, WebP compression and lazy loading
  • Schema markup: Organization, LocalBusiness, Product, FAQ, Article, Breadcrumb
  • Open Graph tags so links look right when shared

Content quality

  • Thin pages expanded; outdated content refreshed
  • E-E-A-T signals: author info, sources, trust elements
  • FAQ blocks that target "People Also Ask" and AI Overviews
  • Short summaries (TL;DR) and scannable formatting
  • Clear calls to action on money pages

Internal linking

  • Contextual links between related pages with descriptive anchor text
  • Orphan pages found and linked
  • Pillar-and-cluster structure for key topics
  • Breadcrumb navigation

You receive

  • →Page-by-page optimization sheet (before → after)
  • →Changes made directly in your CMS, or a developer-ready doc
  • →Keyword-to-URL map you keep

Best for

Sites with traffic potential that aren't ranking or converting yet

Timeline

2–4 weeks for 20–50 pages

Start with On-Page SEO

Technical SEO Audit

20 tasks included

A complete health check of how Google and AI search engines crawl, index and load your site, with a prioritized fix list.

Crawling & indexing

  • Full site crawl (Screaming Frog + Semrush)
  • Google Search Console index coverage review
  • robots.txt and XML sitemap check and cleanup
  • Canonical tags and noindex audit
  • Redirect chains, loops and 404 / broken links
  • Server errors (5xx) and mixed content
  • Duplicate and thin content detection
  • hreflang setup for multilingual or multi-country sites

Speed & Core Web Vitals

  • LCP, INP and CLS diagnosis on key templates
  • Image size, format and lazy-loading fixes
  • Render-blocking scripts and CSS
  • Caching and server response time
  • Mobile usability issues

Site architecture

  • Click depth: key pages within 3 clicks of the homepage
  • URL structure, pagination and filter/faceted pages
  • Internal link flow to priority pages
  • HTTPS and security checks

AI search readiness

  • AI crawler access check (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, Google-Extended)
  • Structured data validation
  • Clear entity and brand signals for AI answers

You receive

  • →Prioritized audit ranked by impact × effort
  • →Developer-ready tickets with exact fixes
  • →Before/after site health score
  • →Walkthrough session to explain every finding

Best for

New clients, site migrations, sudden traffic drops

Timeline

1–2 weeks

Start with Technical SEO Audit

Google Business Profile (GMB)

20 tasks included

Show up in the Google Maps "Local Pack" when nearby customers search, and turn profile views into calls, visits and bookings.

Profile setup & optimization

  • Claim, verify or recover your profile
  • Primary and secondary categories chosen from competitor research
  • Keyword-rich business description
  • Every service and product listed with descriptions and prices
  • Attributes, opening hours, holiday hours and service areas
  • Consistent business name, address and phone (NAP) everywhere
  • Booking, menu or appointment links with UTM tracking

Photos & posts

  • Photo and video plan: logo, cover, team, location, products
  • Weekly Google Posts: offers, updates, events and news
  • Seasonal and holiday campaign posts

Reviews & reputation

  • Review-generation system: templates, QR codes, follow-up messages
  • Professional replies to every review, in Arabic or English
  • Handling and de-escalating negative reviews
  • Reporting fake or spam reviews

Local rankings

  • Local citations on trusted directories, Apple Maps and Bing Places
  • Location landing pages on your website linked to the profile
  • LocalBusiness schema on your site
  • Map-grid rank tracking across your service area
  • Competitor profile analysis
  • Guideline compliance to avoid suspension

You receive

  • →Fully optimized, verified profile
  • →Monthly posting calendar
  • →Review reply templates
  • →Monthly local report: calls, direction requests, website clicks, map rankings

Best for

Clinics, schools, real estate, restaurants, stores, service businesses
